title: [GMCP 203.047.02] Production path: Documentation, examples, developer experience, release quality, and SLOs
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-047-02. Implement the canonical state, types, and primary production path. Replace stubs, demo-only paths, duplicated semantics, and implicit ambient state; preserve compatible behavior through explicit adapters; and make the new path reachable from the shipped GMCP runtime. Vector outcome: Versioned operator, author, host, security, migration, troubleshooting and architecture documentation is executable and matches shipped behavior; examples cover every primitive and official extension from minimal to production. One-command setup and diagnostics pass usability studies, releases carry compatibility/SBOM/provenance evidence, and published availability, recovery, performance and support SLOs are measured with error-budget policy. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
